design_decision: Did NOT extend topic panel via text extraction for 2021-2022. Reason: 2021-2022 companies use GRI Standards 2016 (no GRI 3-3 construct); mixing text-regex (2021-2022) with GRI-table extraction (2023-2024) would introduce method-source confound at treatment boundary. Instead, built binary panel from canonical_codes_str using identical GRI-code methodology across all 4 years.
